answer.narrative: The ATT&CK campaign C0001, named Frankenstein, was described by security researchers as a highly-targeted campaign conducted by moderately sophisticated and highly resourceful unidentified threat actors in early 2019. The actors primarily relied on open source tools, including Empire (S0363), and the name refers to their ability to piece together several unrelated open-source tool components. The campaign is associated with 13 techniques and 14 sub-techniques.

task.text: What is campaign C0001 in ATT&CK?

results.sub_question: What is campaign C0001 in ATT&CK?
results.query: MATCH (n:Campaign) WHERE n.attack_id IN $ids OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r]-(m) WITH n, CASE WHEN m IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE type(r) END AS rel, CASE WHEN m IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE startNode(r) = n END AS outgoing, CASE WHEN m IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE head(labels(m)) END AS neighbour_label, count(m) AS cnt WITH n, collect(CASE WHEN rel IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE {rel: rel, outgoing: outgoing, label: neighbour_label, count: cnt} END) AS raw WITH n, [f IN raw WHERE f IS NOT NULL] AS facets RETURN n.attack_id AS id, n.name AS name, n.properties_json AS properties_json, facets AS facets LIMIT 300
